name: brahmastra
description: Shared, persistent team memory for your agent: recalls the notes that match each request, and reminds it to store decisions and root causes it settles.

settings.name: Brahmastra URL
settings.description: Your install's API address, without /mcp: https://brahmastra.example.com/v1, or http://localhost:8001.

settings.name: API token
settings.description: A personal API token from the dashboard, Account > API tokens.

settings.name: Workspace
settings.description: The workspace (graph) to read, usually one per project or team.
